CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   B. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.

2. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)

   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

9. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)

13. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)

   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

14. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.

15. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
